verdict.rationale: Greptile exposes much of its dashboard functionality programmatically. `greptile onboard` performs "the same setup the dashboard does" (org creation, Git provider connection, repo enablement). `greptile.json` overrides dashboard review settings. The official MCP server lets agents fetch and resolve comments, manage patterns and read the knowledge base "instead of switching to... the Greptile dashboard". The CLI also runs reviews with an API key. However, no public REST API or OpenAPI spec was found (all probe paths returned 404), and nothing claims full UI parity. missing for 10: documented general-purpose REST API, OpenAPI spec, explicit UI/API parity statement covering admin settings (e.g. Settings → Default Coding Agents, feedback/training), independent corroboration.
